item.title: Council votes to keep PUC governance status quo
item.description: After a tie vote at a special council meeting Monday night, Chatham-Kent’s Public Utilities Commission will stick with its current governance structure, at least until the next council term. A report last year from consulting firm KPMG had recommended dissolving the commission, creating a water and wastewater services department, and other measures to improve efficiency […]
